mapper.select: select r.name as label, count(u.id) as cnt from sys_role r left join sys_user u on u.role_id = r.id and u.status = 1 and u.dept_id = #{deptId} group by r.id, r.name, r.level order by r.level
select coalesce(u.education, '未填') as label, count(*) as cnt from sys_user u where u.status = 1 and u.dept_id = #{deptId} group by u.education order by cnt desc
